subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Great leaders don’t ignore __trivial__ things.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Small**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Trivial **means something that is of little importance, significance, or complexity. (कुछ ऐसा जो कम महत्व, महत्व या जटिलता का हो)

 
 
• **Example**: Although the error in the document was minor and trivial, attention to detail is crucial in professional writing.
 
 
 
• Marked option **Small **means something of little
